task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Use Stim's TableauSimulator to verify GHZ stabilizer measurement statistics: prepare 6-qubit GHZ, measure the stabilizer X⊗...⊗X via an ancilla (Hadamard test pattern), and confirm it is deterministic +1 while individual Z measurements are random. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
